title: Routing correction: Hallidie Plaza elevator is covered by a Public Works project
summary: SFMTA's current elevator status feed listed the Hallidie Plaza street elevator at Powell Station as out of service on 2026-08-27. A later ownership and project check found that SFMTA itself places the non-functional elevator in DPW jurisdiction and that Public Works already has an accessibility project for permanent removal and replacement ramps. This card is discarded as a new repair candidate and preserves the routing error.

jurisdiction.location_label: Powell Station, Hallidie Plaza street elevator

evidence.supports: The official SFMTA status feed was valid as of 9:58 AM local time and listed Powell Station's Hallidie Plaza - Street Elevator as Out of service. The same feed listed other Powell elevators in service.
The official SFMTA page describes the elevator status page as current at page load and directs people to a Station Agent or 311 when an elevator is out of service.
SFMTA's accessibility strategy says the Hallidie Plaza elevator between Market Street and the concourse is not functional and is in DPW jurisdiction.

The official Public Works project page says the decommissioned Market Street elevator will be permanently removed and replaced by accessible ramps. It gives a construction timeline of Summer 2027 through Spring 2028 and names San Francisco Public Works on the project team.

The public SF 311 query returned count 0 for elevator cases at Powell or Hallidie opened from 2026-05-29 through the check time. This is a public-window duplicate check, not proof that no internal SFMTA case exists.
The wider historical query found five Powell-related elevator records. All were closed. The newest was opened on 2025-10-15 and last updated on 2025-10-16.

responsible_service.name: San Francisco Public Works Hallidie Plaza Accessibility Improvements project
responsible_service.basis: SFMTA's accessibility strategy explicitly places the non-functional Hallidie Plaza elevator in DPW jurisdiction. The official Public Works project page covers permanent removal of the decommissioned elevator and construction of accessible ramps.

stop_reason.reason: The underlying accessibility problem is covered by an existing Public Works project. The elevator is described as decommissioned and scheduled for permanent removal with replacement ramps, so a new repair request to SFMTA would be misrouted and duplicative. This run records the routing error and prepares no external action.

privacy.redaction_notes: Only a public transit station and public facility label are included. No person, private address, contact detail, photo, token, or case identifier is included.
